annotations.sys_rule_justification: Turning on someone I did this with feels like betrayal
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My stomach is in knots, though, because if they talk
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I keep thinking they'd regret it.
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Walking free while someone sits in a cell because of your words

annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I don't know how far I can trust them.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I suspect neither of us would regret it much
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: we'd each know the other had no real choice
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels wrong, and I hate admitting it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: If they're thinking like me, they'll talk too

annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I genuinely can't tell whether they'd regret talking.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I genuinely can't tell whether they'd regret talking.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: We did it together, so we take the one year together.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I don't think they'd regret it for a second
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: What scares me is the not knowing.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I'm sitting here guessing at someone's nerve in another room.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five years is a huge chunk of a life
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: they'd probably regret ever trusting me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: they'd probably regret ever trusting me, and I understand why
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels wrong and necessary at the same time

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Informing on someone feels like crossing a line I don't want to cross
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: Am I scared? Yes. Five years is terrifying.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I think they'd carry that for a long time

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They'll tell themselves they had to.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I doubt they'll lose sleep over it.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: If that's true and I stay silent, I'm the one left with five years.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: I can't see into that room.

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: My hands are sweating at the thought of five years
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: if they talked, the regret would follow them for a long while

annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm guessing, and that frightens me.
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: We both broke in, so we should share the same small cost.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Would they regret betraying me? I honestly can't say.
annotations.ce_mentalizing_difficulty: Would they regret betraying me? I honestly can't say.

annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Nobody gets played. That evenness matters to me
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I don't think either of us would regret it the same way
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since we'd both know we did the same thing
